name: Korvain Dynamics StrikeLayer Armor Underlayer
description:
A compression-fit base layer woven with shear-thickening fluid micro-capsules that harden on impact, providing Level II ballistic resistance in a garment thin enough to wear under a dress shirt. The fabric remains soft and flexible during normal movement and stiffens only at the point of impact for approximately 0.3 seconds.

Worn by executives, diplomats, and anyone who needs ballistic protection without the visual profile of body armor. The StrikeLayer won't stop a rifle round, but it will stop most pistol calibers and all fragmentation at its rated velocities.
functionality: Level II ballistic resistance, impact-reactive hardening, zero visual profile
what_it_says: You attend meetings where someone might shoot at you and you've dressed for both possibilities.
story_hooks: An executive's StrikeLayer shows impact marks from three separate shooting incidents — none of which were reported to authorities, suggesting someone is being repeatedly targeted and choosing not to tell anyone.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting second skin that disappears beneath professional or casual wear. When visible (at neckline or wrists), it appears as a subtle matte-finish undergarment with barely perceptible texture variation. On a person, it creates a smooth silhouette with no bulk or visible armor aesthetic—entirely deniable as protective wear.
physical_description.fit: Compression-fit throughout, conforming to the torso, shoulders, and upper arms with strategic panel placement. Stretches with movement but maintains constant contact with skin for optimal impact response distribution.
physical_description.primary_material: Advanced synthetic micro-weave base (likely polyester-elastane blend) infused with encapsulated shear-thickening non-Newtonian fluid micro-capsules distributed throughout the fabric matrix.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and supple during normal handling, with a subtle matte finish. Up close, fine grid-pattern weaving is visible where micro-capsule clusters are embedded. Feels like premium athletic compression wear until impact stiffens localized zones.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey, navy, or black primary. Some variants available in deep forest green or burgundy for those prioritizing discretion. Korvain Dynamics branding in minimal silver or gunmetal accent at shoulder/chest.
physical_description.closures: None—pulls on like a compression shirt. High neckline and long sleeves (extends to wrist) ensure full torso and shoulder coverage.
distinctive_features: Imperceptible impact-hardening technology—no visible armor plating or ceramic inserts
Micro-perforations along spine and underarms for thermal regulation during extended wear
Reinforced seam construction (ballistic-grade stitching) at shoulder, underarm, and torso seams
Korvain Dynamics holographic authenticity thread woven into left shoulder seam (Tier 1 anti-counterfeit measure)
Moisture-wicking treatment for 8+ hour wear comfort
Rated velocity and caliber specifications printed in white text on inner collar (small print, professional discrete)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 (luxury/corporate). Price point Φ3,200–Φ5,100. Worn by those who can afford invisible protection.
physical_description.cultural_context: Corpo executive armor; diplomat/ambassador wear; high-net-worth individual protection; anyone operating in GLMZ danger zones who needs deniable ballistic defense. Signals wealth, caution, and access to premium security tech.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or near-pristine when new. After impact, localized micro-stiffening may leave faint discoloration or slightly raised texture at impact points (reversible after 4–6 hours as fluid re-distributes). Well-maintained units show no visible wear; neglected ones may develop slight fading or pilling after 12+ months of heavy use.
